name: next-parallel-routes-monorepo
description: Monorepo for next-parallel-routes (publishable package + runnable examples).

scripts.version:patch: pnpm --filter next-parallel-routes exec npm version patch --no-git-tag-version
scripts.version:minor: pnpm --filter next-parallel-routes exec npm version minor --no-git-tag-version
scripts.version:major: pnpm --filter next-parallel-routes exec npm version major --no-git-tag-version
scripts.release:patch: pnpm version:patch && pnpm --filter next-parallel-routes publish --access public --no-git-checks
scripts.release:minor: pnpm version:minor && pnpm --filter next-parallel-routes publish --access public --no-git-checks
scripts.release:major: pnpm version:major && pnpm --filter next-parallel-routes publish --access public --no-git-checks
